name: learn-anything-fast
title_zh: 一个会先问你「学来干嘛」再定路线的学习教练
tagline_zh: 不背大纲，先找那 20% 最高杠杆知识点；每次只问一题、当场诊断，学完还能用费曼讲一遍——直到你真会了才放你走。
tagline_en: Skip the syllabus. Find the vital 20%, quiz one question at a time, diagnose gaps, and Feynman-teach back until.
desc_en: Build and run a source-grounded, AI-assisted learning loop for any topic or skill. Use when Codex needs to create a learning roadmap, identify the highest-leverage 20 percent, coach a learner interactively, quiz one question at a time, diagnose weak areas, produce a one-page cheat sheet, screen learning resources, run Feynman teach-backs, or turn a vague learning goal into a time-boxed study plan.
why_zh: 它不产出资料堆，而是逼你走完「定目标→找杠杆→互动问答→费曼回讲」的闭环；每次只考一题。
why_en: It's a loop, not a dump: goal → leverage → interactive quiz → teach-back. One question at a time, it pinpoints weaknesses and.
limit_zh: 需要 Codex 环境且联网；只覆盖学习流程设计，不代你执行练习或记忆；产出是路线图、单页速查表与问答脚本。
limit_en: Requires Codex with internet. Designs the learning loop only—no practice execution or memory drills. Outputs roadmaps, one-pagers, and quiz scripts.
title_en: A learning coach that asks why before mapping the route
